SELECT e.emp_no, e.emp_name, e.emp_email, e.emp_dept_no, e.emp_position_no, e.emp_level, e.emp_state, e.emp_presence, e.emp_birth, e.emp_contact, e.emp_post, e.emp_address1, e.emp_address2, e.emp_ctime, e.emp_utime,
/* 사용자 프로필 이미지 */ ep.attach_no AS attachNo
FROM emp e
/* emp → emp_profile → attach */ LEFT JOIN emp_profile ep ON e.emp_no = ep.emp_no
WHERE ( REPLACE( LOWER(e.emp_name), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%'
OR
REPLACE( LOWER(e.emp_email), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%' )
ORDER BY e.emp_no

SELECT p.project_no, p.project_name, p.project_purpose, p.project_visibility, p.project_status, p.project_start, p.project_deadline, p.project_ctime, p.project_utime,
/* ================================================= 프로젝트 참여 인원
inactive 회원은 제외하고 active 회원만 카운트 ================================================= */ ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_member pm_count WHERE pm_count.project_no = p.project_no AND pm_count.project_member_status = 'active' ) AS memberCount,
/* ================================================= 현재 로그인 사용자의 프로젝트 참여 상태
active 상태인 회원만 참여자로 판단
owner → owner member → member 그 외 → NULL ================================================= */ CASE WHEN pm.project_member_role = 'owner' THEN 'owner'
WHEN pm.project_member_no IS NOT NULL THEN 'member'
ELSE NULL END AS projectRole
FROM project p
/* ===================================================== 현재 로그인 사용자의 active 회원 정보만 연결
inactive 상태라면 JOIN되지 않음 → projectRole = NULL → 프론트에서 "참여" 버튼 표시 ===================================================== */ LEFT JOIN project_member pm ON p.project_no = pm.project_no AND pm.emp_no = #{empNo} AND pm.project_member_status = 'active'
WHERE
/* 종료된 프로젝트 제외 */ p.project_status = 'active'
/* private 프로젝트 제외 */ AND p.project_visibility != 'private'
AND ( REPLACE( LOWER(p.project_name), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%'
OR
REPLACE( LOWER(p.project_purpose), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%' )
ORDER BY p.project_ctime DESC

SELECT n.note_no AS noteNo, n.project_no AS projectNo, p.project_name AS projectName,
n.note_writer_no AS noteWriterNo,
writer_pm.emp_no AS writerEmpNo,
writer_emp.emp_name AS writerName,
n.note_title AS noteTitle,
n.note_content AS noteContent,
n.note_ctime AS noteCtime,
n.note_utime AS noteUtime
FROM note n
INNER JOIN project p ON n.project_no = p.project_no
LEFT JOIN project_member writer_pm ON n.note_writer_no = writer_pm.project_member_no
LEFT JOIN emp writer_emp ON writer_pm.emp_no = writer_emp.emp_no
WHERE /* 종료된 프로젝트 제외 */ p.project_status = 'active'
/* private 프로젝트 제외 */ AND p.project_visibility != 'private'
/* 현재 로그인 사용자가 프로젝트의 active 회원인지 확인 */ AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_no = p.project_no AND pm.emp_no = #{empNo} AND pm.project_member_status = 'active' )
AND ( /* 노트 제목 */ REPLACE( LOWER(n.note_title), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%'
OR
/* 노트 내용 - CLOB */ DBMS_LOB.INSTR( REGEXP_REPLACE( LOWER(n.note_content), '[[:space:]]', '' ), REGEXP_REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), '[[:space:]]', '' ) ) > 0 )
ORDER BY n.note_ctime DESC

SELECT DISTINCT a.attach_no, a.attach_name, a.attach_type, a.attach_size, a.attach_uploader, a.attach_source, a.attach_source_no, a.attach_ctime,
e.emp_name AS empName,
p.project_name AS projectName, p.project_no AS projectNo
FROM attach a
LEFT JOIN emp e ON a.attach_uploader = TO_CHAR(e.emp_no)
INNER JOIN project_file pf ON a.attach_no = pf.attach_no
INNER JOIN project p ON pf.project_no = p.project_no
WHERE /* 종료된 프로젝트 제외 */ p.project_status = 'active'
/* private 프로젝트 제외 */ AND p.project_visibility != 'private'
/* 현재 로그인 사용자가 프로젝트의 active 회원인지 확인 */ AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_no = p.project_no AND pm.emp_no = #{empNo} AND pm.project_member_status = 'active' )
AND ( /* 파일명 */ REPLACE( LOWER(a.attach_name), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%'
OR
/* 파일 출처 */ REPLACE( LOWER( CASE WHEN a.attach_source = 'FILE' THEN '파일함'
WHEN a.attach_source = 'NOTE' THEN '노트'
WHEN a.attach_source = 'NOTE_COMMENT' THEN '노트 댓글'
WHEN a.attach_source = 'TASK' THEN '업무'
WHEN a.attach_source = 'TASK_COMMENT' THEN '업무 댓글'
ELSE a.attach_source END ), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%'
OR
/* 업로더 이름 */ REPLACE( LOWER(e.emp_name), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%' )
ORDER BY a.attach_no DESC

SELECT pm.project_no AS projectNo,
p.project_name AS projectName,
pm.project_member_role AS projectMemberRole,
pm.project_member_job AS projectMemberJob,
pm.project_member_ctime AS projectMemberCtime,
p.project_status AS projectStatus
FROM project_member pm
INNER JOIN project p ON pm.project_no = p.project_no
WHERE pm.emp_no = #{_parameter}
ORDER BY pm.project_member_ctime DESC
